title: Camp Huston

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Not sure what to expect for your first time at Camp Huston? We’re here to help, from beginning to end! All campers will stay in cabins which can house ten people each, including a counselor or two. Campers can use sheets and blankets or their sleeping bag to stay comfy in their bunk beds. Across from the cabins is a community bathhouse, which has hot running water for the showers. The field in between can be used for frisbee, soccer, or any other activities!
